about: Extract of https://api.census.gov/data.json fetched at step zero, 2026-10-16 ~09:30 UTC (the 5.2 MB catalogue itself is not kept). Every dataset whose path starts pep, cbp, acs/acs1, acs/acs5, geoinfo, dec/pl or timeseries/eits/resconst, and every title mentioning permits or building. No county Building Permits Survey dataset is listed; the latest listed vintages are acs5 2024, acs1 2024, cbp 2023, pep/charv 2023, geoinfo 2025.
